subject: Money
title: When Money Dies
description: Learn When Money Dies in one minute.

hook.text: In Hungary in 1946, prices doubled every 15 hours. The government printed a 100-quintillion pengo note.

buildup.text: Hyperinflation always follows the same script: crisis, printing, denial, collapse, new currency.

discovery.text: The pattern: government can't tax enough, can't borrow enough, so it prints. Each round of printing worsens trust.

twist.text: Hyperinflation has never happened to a country with an independent central bank and strong institutions.

climax.text: Money dies when governments prioritize short-term survival over long-term trust. Institutions matter.

punchline.text: Printing money is the last resort. Then the currency is.

quiz.question: What prevents hyperinflation?
options: Independent central banks and strong institutions
